supersedes: nothing; extends protocol 1.0 (configs/protocol.json), whose results are frozen in results/v1_freeze/MANIFEST_v1.sha256
title: Physiology-Aligned Multiresolution Analysis for Patient-Independent Heart-Murmur Detection: A Comparative Study of Wavelet and Fourier Features
research_question: Does cardiac-cycle timing alignment improve patient-independent murmur detection, and does the wavelet-vs-Fourier choice matter once alignment is controlled?
unchanged_from_v1: binary Present vs Absent, Unknown excluded
WPD depth 4, db4 primary, order=freq, periodization

representations.wpd: WPD db4 raw squared coefficients (v1 primary)
representations.wpds: WPD db4 energies smoothed along time with the STFT's 64-sample Hann (4-tap over level-4 columns) -- now pre-registered

conditions.perm: PRIMARY NULL: column labels randomly permuted within each recording (np.random.default_rng(crc32(rec_id)).permutation); same counts of S1/systole/S2/diastole/unannotated, timing destroyed; same 34-feature definitions
conditions.shift: SECONDARY NULL: label sequence circularly shifted by u*T columns, u ~ U(0.2,0.8) from the same seeded RNG, T = median S1-to-S1 interval of that recording (0.6 s if <2 S1 events); caveat: shifts near 0.5T can partly invert systole/diastole

hypotheses.H5d_secondary: RF AUROC(true) - AUROC(shift) >= 0.03 for each representation

E2_isolate_alignment.rule: SUPPORTED iff delta >= 0.03 AND subject-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND delta > 0 in >= 18/25 outer folds; otherwise NOT SUPPORTED
E2_isolate_alignment.interpretation_if_not_supported: the v1 aligned-pipeline gain is attributed to feature definitions/normalisation, not to physiological timing

E1_automatic_segmentation.segmenter: unsupervised, uses no murmur labels and no expert .tsv: (1) homomorphic envelope of the 25-400 Hz band (|Hilbert| -> log -> 8 Hz low-pass -> exp, 50 Hz rate); (2) heart period T = envelope autocorrelation peak in [0.3, 1.5] s; (3) heart-sound peaks = envelope local maxima with min spacing 0.2*T and height >= 25th percentile of envelope; (4) consecutive peak intervals paired, shorter interval of each pair = systole (S1 -> S2), longer = diastole (S2 -> S1); (5) S1/S2 extents = contiguous region around the peak where envelope >= 50% of the peak value, clipped to [40, 160] ms; (6) everything else labelled 0 only if no valid pairing exists
E1_automatic_segmentation.parameter_freeze: all constants above are fixed now; no tuning on classification results. Any change must be justified by segmentation metrics only (no murmur labels) and logged as an amendment before rerunning classification
E1_automatic_segmentation.segmentation_evaluation: against expert .tsv inside expert-annotated spans: S1 and S2 centre detection F1 with +/-50 ms tolerance; frame-wise 4-state accuracy

hypotheses.H6b: RF AUROC(auto, wpd) > AUROC(B1) with subject-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
hypotheses.H6c: same as H6a/H6b for stft and wpds (reported, same rule)

E1_automatic_segmentation.flag: if S1/S2 F1 < 0.70 the downstream result is still reported, flagged as 'low-quality segmentation'

E3_soft_murmurs.status: optional, run only if E1 and E2 are complete by 2026-10-30
E3_soft_murmurs.feature: per recording: log(mean systolic energy in 62.5-187.5 Hz / mean S1 energy in 62.5-187.5 Hz) using wpd and stft maps, added to the aligned set
E3_soft_murmurs.hypothesis: H7: sensitivity on grade I/VI Present patients at the spec80 operating point increases by >= 0.05 with overall RF AUROC not below the v1 value minus 0.01

equivalence_report: for wpds vs stft (aligned, true labels): report delta and 95% CI; say 'no meaningful difference' only if the whole CI lies within +/-0.03
forbidden: as v1; additionally: no re-selection of segmenter constants, null definitions, or representations after seeing E1/E2 classification results
